reviews.text: Our dog Benny goes here regularly and loves it, he stays for daycare and has stayed overnight as well. He is always very well taken care of, everyone who works there is clearly very experienced and loves dogs. They are easy to deal with and easily contactable.

Could not be happier with this dog boarding service. We have a large Dutch shep/lab (Bowie) who was an absolute menace at home. We went on hols in May and used Fidos 4eva kennels to board him for 8 nights for the first time. We've previously used dog sitters who would eventually decline boarding him again based on his bolstered behaviour. Weve had a consistent dog behaviourist specialist to work with Bowie and their methods they used never worked for him and us. He was eventually medicated for his behaviour, which we were against. But after we boarded him with this gang he came back a whole other better version of himself. He sits on command, takes his food on command, settles on command etc. He isn't jumping on us upon our arrival home. We are delighted to have found this boarding kennel because not only are they minding our dogs they are putting work in with them also. Looking forward to having him board in future.

Cannot recommend Fido’s enough . Absolutely fantastic
Thank you so much

We have been taking our dog Lola here for stays while we are away for a good few years now.She is always happy when she arrives and always worn out when we collect her . They very much encourage canine interaction with the other dogs who are staying/day stays which our dog thrives on.The staff and management are friendly ,professional and the communication is very straightforward. It's good to have somewhere where she can stay and we don't have to worry about her.Thanks kerina and team ,see you all soon.

I can't believe this place is still allowed to look after dogs this was once called P&E BOARDING KENNELLS they will say they are not affiliated with the previous owners, but they are and still are and this place is being run by the same people. This is the place that wrapped up a husky dog in a plastic bag after the dog died in their care this was  someone's pet they were being paid to look after. When the owner of the dog came to collect their did the person in this place just handed her the bag with her dog in it. Avoid this place

I left my 3-month-old Frenchie with the guys for 4 nights, a very professional, clean and friendly place. My Frenchie came back exhausted from playing with the other dogs, no issues, very happy little dog. I even got a video to show me Rollo playing with other dogs, and that he was doing fine.  Highly recommend this kennel.

*Edit* They've since rebranded AGAIN to "Fidos4eva Kennels"
*Edit Oct. 22nd 2025* They had to rebrand several times because more than several dogs have died under their care. They ARE still operated by the same family and man who abused these poor animals earlier.
They have, and will threaten those who speak out about them.
DO NOT leave your dogs here. DO NOT.
I don't usually write reviews, but it's best to never leave your dogs here.  Also, finding out that this is " P&E " rebranded, from the reviews solidifies everything. Don't bring your pets here.
PLEASE, DO NOT BRING YOUR LOVED PETS HERE.
My dog absolutely loves Fidos 4 Eva day care everyday when we pull up outside he  gets so excited. Emmet and Kerina are brilliant you can see what dog lovers they are ❤️

My French Bulldog came home from Fidos Kennels (formerly P&E Kennels- please research this) with life-threatening heatstroke (42°C temperature) and had to be rushed to the vet. Fidos took no responsibility, offered no apology or compensation. Would not trust them with any dog.

Can't believe this place is still in business. Left my dog here a few years ago and when it was called P & E boarding and she came home vomiting, smelled awful and could barely make a sound when trying to bark. When I contacted them they said nothing had happened while she was there but they lied as a dog had died that weekend and it seems lots got sick. Luckily my dog got better but it cost a lot vets bills. Avoid this place.

We had a good experience with the team, everyone was very kind and helpful.
Even though our dog didn’t adapt to the kennel, they were honest, caring and called us right away.
They clearly love animals and they put the dog first. We will back to try the daycare. Thank you!
Have left my dog here a few times and I am very happy with this service, it's local, good price and staff are lovely, will always use this place, thank you

Left my dogs here for one week while on holiday they were very happy and looked well looked after when I collected them Karina seems like a lovely person from my experience and my dogs were happy and healthy when I arrived to collect them they were a bit smelly but that's sort of to be expected 🤣🤣🤣. Also got a few video updates and they looked extremely happy in them. Also one was extremely afraid of everything as we got her at 5months and I don't know what trama she experienced but was far more confident and relaxed coming home which was brilliant thank you so much guys 💖.
Brilliant excellent service i have been using hotel for pets for the last 4 years would highly recommend
